assetPlayer.unsupported: Your browser does not support audio!

history.empty: You currently have no listening history. As you listen to recordings on the map, they will be displayed here for further discovery.

timeMachine.title: Time machine
timeMachine.notAvailableBody: This project's time machine isn't open.

addVoice.moveCloser: Move closer to a speaker location to record

outOfRange.title: Out of Range
outOfRange.message: You are out of range of this project. Please go somewhere within range and try again. Thank you.

assetActions.flag: tell us you are concerned about this one!
assetActions.like: tell us you like this one!

locationRequired.title: Location Access Required
locationRequired.body: Enabling location is necessary to participate fully in the artwork experience. Your location data won't be saved or shared.

outOfRange.title: Out of Range!
outOfRange.message: Walking Mode is currently unavailable at your location! You can still continue with Map mode.

permissionDenied.title: Permission Denied!
permissionDenied.message: Permission to access your location was denied! Please try again and allow to use walking mode.

failedToDetermineLocation.title: Failed to determine location!
failedToDetermineLocation.message: There was an error determining your location! Please try again.

geolocationTimeout.title: Location request timed out!
geolocationTimeout.message: It took too long to get your location. Go near a window/outdoors and tap Try Again.

insecureContext.title: Insecure connection
insecureContext.message: Geolocation requires HTTPS. Please open the site over a secure (https://) connection.

offline.title: No internet connection
offline.message: You're offline. Connect to the internet and try again.

positionUnavailable.title: Position unavailable
positionUnavailable.message: Location services may be off or unavailable. Enable Location Services and Precise/High accuracy, then try again.

locationServicesOff.title: Location services are off!
locationServicesOff.message: Please enable Location Services in your device settings and try again. On iOS: Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services. On Android: Settings → Location. Also ensure your browser has Precise/High accuracy enabled.

walkingModeNotSupported.title: Walking Mode not supported!
walkingModeNotSupported.message: Your browser doesn't support Walking Mode.
